rulings.restated: Subtract line 8 from line 7. If zero or less, enter -0-.
rulings.model: The IRS line 9 is conditional: “Is the amount on line 8 less than the amount on line 7? No. STOP None of your social security benefits are taxable... Yes. Subtract line 8 from line 7.” The restatement instead always subtracts and floors at zero, omitting the No/STOP condition.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 32, worksheet line 9: "Is the amount on line 8 less than the amount on line 7? No. None of your social security benefits are taxable. Enter -0- on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 6b. ... STOP". On the No branch the restatement's floor gives $0, and the round-2 display conditions stop the worksheet there (ssb.past9 is line 9 above zero; ssb.show10_15 hides lines 10 to 15 and ssb.show16_18 hides lines 16 to 18 unless married filing separately and living together, a return refused by s3.mfs), so no amount is shown past the STOP. Project stands.
